dashboard.label: Mini-SOC Security Monitoring
dashboard.description: Windows Security Monitoring and Threat Detection

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" | stats count as Total
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | stats count as Failed
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625) | eval Login_Status=if(EventCode=4624,"Successful","Failed") | timechart span=1h count by Login_Status

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | rex field=Message "Kontoen pålogging mislyktes for:[\s\S]*?Kontonavn:\s*(?<target_account>[^\r\n]+)" | eval target_account=trim(target_account) | where isnotnull(target_account) AND target_account!="-" | stats count as Failed_Attempts by target_account | sort - Failed_Attempts | head 10

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | rex field=Message "Kontoen pålogging mislyktes for:[\s\S]*?Kontonavn:\s*(?<account>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "Påloggingstype:\s*(?<logon_type>\d+)" | rex field=Message "Adresse til kildenettverk:\s*(?<source_ip>[^\r\n]+)" | eval account=trim(account), source_ip=trim(source_ip) | table _time account logon_type source_ip | sort - _time

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 | rex field=Message "Kontoen pålogging mislyktes for:[\s\S]*?Kontonavn:\s*(?<account>[^\r\n]+)" | eval account=trim(account) | where isnotnull(account) AND account!="-" | bin _time span=5m | stats count as Failed_Attempts by _time, account | where Failed_Attempts >= 5 | eval Detection="SOC-001", Severity="Medium", Status="INVESTIGATE" | table _time Detection account Failed_Attempts Severity Status | appendpipe [ stats count as matches | where matches=0 | eval Detection="SOC-001", Status="NO DETECTIONS" | table Detection Status ] | sort - _time
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4672 | timechart span=1h count as Privileged_Events
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" | stats count by EventCode | sort - count | head 10
